findings.text: Ask 4 is not done: `git diff --cached --name-only` still lists the same 212 stray files saved in `stray-staged-before.txt`. Run `git restore --staged --pathspec-from-file=stray-staged-before.txt` (unstages only) and record that it ran.

The diff includes an unrequested change: `Server/Worktrees.mjs` `merged_stale`, its test, `Server/worktree-servers.mjs` and `Server/doc/worktree-servers.md`. It has nothing to do with merge staging, so it belongs in its own task (or the task folder must say why it rode along).

`Server/merge.mjs:~644` still prints `overlap.length ? overlap.join(", ") : "staged files"` in the three-way branch, but the `else` is now reached only when `overlap` is non-empty. Drop the dead "staged files" fallback.

`commitLanded`'s final `git reset -q HEAD -- <landed paths>` (merge.mjs ~line 141) would silently drop another agent's staged edit if it sat on a path this merge lands. That is a narrow overlap and the files are dirty-checked first, but it is not covered by a test.
The new tests (strays untouched, deletion, refused conflict leaves index/HEAD/MERGE_HEAD/temp index clean) match ask 3 well; no test runs a failed `commitLanded` (the "NOT COMMITTED" path, exit 1).

Docs: `Server/doc/review.md` and `commit-rule.md` were updated as asked, and the file header comment matches the new behaviour. A fresh agent can continue from the task folder (requirements, past-work, stray list), but nothing records that asks 1 and 4 (the reproduction and the index clean) were actually carried out.
